findings.evidence: `cone` (line 152), `coneSimplex` and `uncone` are `private`. The public lemmas cover only the `join.inr` restriction (line 287) and `op ⦋0⦌` (line 298).
findings.fix: Add a `@[simp]` lemma `cosliceIso_hom_app_coe` for every n, stating that the coslice simplex equals `(join.stdSimplexIso 0 n).hom ≫ stdSimplex.map (eqToHom _) ≫ SSet.yonedaEquiv.symm ((ComposableArrows.underEquiv x n).symm s).1`. Add a matching `cosliceIso_inv_app` lemma, stating that the inverse is `ComposableArrows.underEquiv x n` applied to the string read off through the join isomorphism together with its first-vertex proof.
findings.issue: The only characterizing lemmas for `cosliceIso` are `cosliceIso_hom_base` (projection) and `cosliceIso_hom_app_vertex` (n = 0). Nothing gives the full coslice simplex `(coslice.objEquiv ((cosliceIso x).hom.app (op ⦋n⦌) s)).1` for general n, and nothing describes `(cosliceIso x).inv`. Downstream users such as the comma-pullback identification would have to unfold the private `cone`.

findings.evidence: `Join/StdSimplex.lean` already exports `stdSimplexIso`, `inl_comp_stdSimplexIso_hom` (line 361) and `δ_zero_comp_stdSimplexIso_inv` (line 380). The n = 0 specialization with δ 0 naturality is missing there.
findings.fix: Move them to `TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialSet/Join/StdSimplex.lean` as public declarations next to `join.stdSimplexIso` (e.g. `join.stdSimplexZeroIso`), with the inl, inr and naturality lemmas tagged `@[reassoc]`.
findings.issue: `coneIso`, `coneIso_inl`, `coneIso_inr` and `coneIso_naturality` are `private`. Their statements mention only `join`, `Δ[n]` and `SimplexCategory` and their proofs never use nerves, so this is general standard-simplex infrastructure (the cone on Δ[n] as Δ[n+1], natural in Δ[n]).

findings.evidence: `JoinVertex.lean` lines 73-91 define `joinVertex` with `joinVertex_map_castSucc` and `joinVertex_map_last`. No left-vertex counterpart exists there, and `prepend_zero` and `prepend_succ` need `erw` through `rev_map_apply`.
findings.fix: Expose it in `TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/SimplexCategory/JoinVertex.lean` as a public functor (e.g. `SimplexCategory.vertexJoin`) with `@[simp]` lemmas `vertexJoin_map_zero` and `vertexJoin_map_succ`, parallel to `joinVertex_map_last` and `joinVertex_map_castSucc`.
findings.issue: `prepend` (`rev ⋙ joinVertex ⋙ rev`, joining a vertex on the left) and its characterizing lemmas `prepend_zero`, `prepend_succ` and `prepend_eq` are `private`. They are general `SimplexCategory` infrastructure, the left dual of the public `SimplexCategory.joinVertex`.

summary: `cosliceIso` has lemmas only for the projection and for vertices: no formula for arbitrary n-simplices and none for the inverse, so consumers must unfold private `cone`. The cone isomorphism `join Δ[0] Δ[n] ≅ Δ[n+1]` and the left vertex-join map `prepend` are general standard-simplex infrastructure hidden as `private`.
